resolvedFindings.finding: The proof invoked the line-plane criterion without first establishing that the candidate lines are not contained in the second plane.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The revised argument first excludes A from the second plane by uniqueness of a plane through two crossing directions, then applies theorem 5.1 and theorem 5.2.

resolvedFindings.finding: The area proof passed from a triangle with a conveniently placed side to a general polygon without the arbitrary-triangle reduction.
resolvedFindings.resolution: An explicit cut parallel to the plane intersection reduces an arbitrary triangle to two special triangles, with parallel translation of the projection plane and additivity. The alpha=0 and alpha=90 boundary discussion remains separate.

resolvedFindings.finding: The length of an inclined prism edge was described as usually larger than the height.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Now states it is always larger because it is an incline to the base plane.

resolvedFindings.finding: The apothem was described as usually larger than the pyramid height.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Now states SM>SO and supplies SM^2=SO^2+OM^2 with OM>0.
